title: NovaKits
description: A highly customizable kit plugin with GUI editing, permissions, cooldowns, previews, and full inventory-based management.
body:
# NovaKits

A modern and highly customizable Minecraft kit plugin that gives server owners complete control over their kit system through an intuitive in-game GUI.

Perfect for KitPvP, Practice, Survival, Minigames, and large server networks.

## ✨ Features

### 🖥️ GUI-Based Management

* Full inventory-based kit editor
* Create, edit, and delete kits in-game
* No complicated configuration files
* Interactive admin panels
* Easy drag-and-drop editing

### 🎨 Customization

* Custom kit icons
* Editable kit names
* Custom lore and descriptions
* Multiple kit pages
* Fully customizable layouts

### 🎁 Player Features

* Preview kits before claiming
* Auto-equip armor
* Toggle between normal give and shulker box give
* Smooth and intuitive claiming experience

### ⏰ Cooldowns & Permissions

* Per-kit cooldowns
* Rank-based cooldowns
* Global cooldowns
* Permission support
* Permission bypass support
* Kit groups

### 📚 Advanced Management

* Move kits between pages
* Reset kits instantly
* Enable or disable kits
* Edit items directly from inventory
* Manage permissions in-game

## 📋 Commands

### Player Commands

* `/kit`
* `/kit <kit>`
* `/kits`

### Admin Commands

* `/kitadmin create`
* `/kitadmin delete`
* `/kitadmin edit`
* `/kitadmin editloot`
* `/kitadmin enable`
* `/kitadmin disable`
* `/kitadmin give`
* `/kitadmin groups`
* `/kitadmin perms`
* `/kitadmin cooldown`
* `/kitadmin rankcooldown`
* `/kitadmin globalrankcooldown`
* `/kitadmin iconhand`
* `/kitadmin rename`
* `/kitadmin slot`
* `/kitadmin page`
* `/kitadmin preview`
* `/kitadmin reset`
* `/kitadmin resetcooldown`
* `/kitadmin loot`
* `/kitadmin list`

## 🎯 Perfect For

* KitPvP Servers
* Practice Servers
* Survival Servers
* Minigames
* Custom Server Networks

## 🚀 Why NovaKits?

NovaKits is designed to provide a powerful yet easy-to-use kit management experience. Manage every aspect of your server's kits directly in-game while giving players a polished and professional interface.

No complex setup. No endless configuration files. Just powerful kit management.

# 🔐 LuckPerms Integration

NovaKits integrates seamlessly with LuckPerms, allowing you to restrict kits by player ranks/groups or permissions.

## Rank/Group Based Kits

Assign a kit to one or more LuckPerms groups:

```bash
/kitadmin groups vipkit vip
```

Only players in the `vip` group can claim `vipkit`.

Multiple groups can be assigned:

```bash
/kitadmin groups vipkit vip,mvp,owner
```

Players in `vip`, `mvp`, or `owner` will be able to claim the kit.

## Permission Based Kits

Assign a permission to a kit:

```bash
/kitadmin perms vipkit novakits.kit.vipkit
```

Grant the permission through LuckPerms:

```bash
/lp group vip permission set novakits.kit.vipkit true
```

Players with the permission will be able to claim the kit.

## Required Permission

Players must have the base NovaKits permission:

```bash
/lp group default permission set novakits.use true
```

This permission is required to open and use kits.

## LuckPerms Examples

Give a player a rank:

```bash
/lp user Steve parent add vip
```

Remove a rank:

```bash
/lp user Steve parent remove vip
```

View a player's groups:

```bash
/lp user Steve parent info
```

Grant kit access:

```bash
/lp group vip permission set novakits.kit.vipkit true
```

## Rank Cooldowns

Set different cooldowns based on player ranks:

```bash
/kitadmin rankcooldown vipkit vip 12h
/kitadmin rankcooldown vipkit mvp 6h
/kitadmin rankcooldown vipkit owner 20m
```

Example:

* VIP → 12 Hours
* MVP → 6 Hours
* Owner → 20 Minutes

## Global Rank Cooldowns

Apply cooldowns across all kits for a specific rank:

```bash
/kitadmin globalrankcooldown founder 20m
```

This gives the `founder` rank a 20-minute cooldown across all kits unless a kit-specific rank cooldown overrides it.

## Two Ways To Control Access

### Option 1: Rank-Based Access

```bash
/kitadmin groups vipkit vip,mvp,owner
```

### Option 2: Permission-Based Access

```bash
/kitadmin perms vipkit novakits.kit.vipkit
/lp group vip permission set novakits.kit.vipkit true
```

Use whichever system best fits your server setup.
